findings.detail: Homeward, Inc. has a fixed 19.00% stated interest rate in the SOI, but the extracted row carries basis_spread=19.0 as if it were a reference-rate spread.

citation.quoted_text: Homeward, Inc. | Growth Capital Loan ( 19.00 % interest rate, 9.75 % EOT payment) | 12/30/2021 | 3,053 | 3,385 | 3,358 | 6/30/2026

rationale: C115 flags basis_spread=19.0. The raw SOI row for Homeward, Inc. states a fixed 19.00% interest rate and 9.75% EOT payment, with no reference index or spread term such as Prime/SOFR + 19.00%. The flagged value is therefore a field-level extraction error: the fixed coupon was stored in basis_spread rather than only as the stated interest rate.
